system.description:
You prepare a full power shot, putting all of your Strength behind it. This attack cannot be made at disadvantage and ignores a creatures Temporary Hit Points dealing damage directly to the targets hit points.

Make a ranged taijutsu attack dealing your [Weapons damage] + 4d12.If you score a critical hit, reduce the target creatures DR (damage reduction) by 6 until they spend an Action to repair it.

Chain 2: This attack gains a +2 bonus to its critical threat range.

Chain 3: When this jutsu is cast, you can select up to 2 additional creatures within 30 feet of the original target as you ricochet your shot between them. On a successful attack, remake your attack with this jutsu targeting the second creature applying its effects on a hit. If the second attack scores a hit, then remake your attack with this jutsu targeting the third creature applying its effects on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
